title: Louis Armstrong's arrest, and Honey Murphy's
summary: Armstrong's setup arrest by a corrupt cop and the unmusical Honey Murphy's.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: I've heard that there was a place, one of the early after-hours places was way down on Central Avenue called Honey's or (inaudible)?

Yeah, that was way out. That was way back in the late '30s and in the '40s. That's way out. That was -- didn't too much happen out there, music-wise. Some other things was happening out there that I would rather not mention. But there was a lot going on. They used to do a lot of gambling and things and plenty of whiskey and ladies and things like that, you know. But that was just a joint. There was no musical attraction there at all, quite unmusical.
I had heard that there was (inaudible).
